title: Restricted scheme relation and its two endpoint maps
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], let $R,U,U'$ be schemes over $S$, and let $s,t:R\to U$ and $q:U'\to U$ be morphisms over $S$. Define the restricted relation to be the iterated fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] $R'=U'\times_{q,U,s}R\times_{t,U,q}U'$. Its source $s':R'\to U'$ is the first endpoint projection and its target $t':R'\to U'$ is the last endpoint projection. Thus over a test $S$-scheme $T$ its triples $(x,r,y)$ satisfy $qx=sr$ and $tr=qy$, and the two endpoint maps send such a triple to $x$ and $y$, respectively. This construction is defined for arbitrary $s,t,q$; it requires no groupoid structure, monicity, etaleness or covering hypothesis.
